_comment: The hilot: single fused piece, A-pose, empty hands, legs hidden in an ankle-length patadyong. Symmetric, so the right side is mirrored from the left. Joint positions measured on hilot.blend with tools/blender/slice_model.py and the front and side renders (its own units, 0.978 tall; faces -Y, her left is +X). Used by tools/blender/rig_humanoid.py.
